blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A language-model agent is jointly defined by its model and its harness, the executable program that organizes model calls, tool use, and information flow. Because different tasks call for different ways of organizing these operations, the harness needs to be adapted using feedback from the task at hand. We introduce harness learning , which trains a proposer model to revise a solver’s harness using execution feedback. We formulate this process as meta-learning over executable programs, with harness revisions playing the role of weight updates in gradient-based adaptation. We train the proposer with reinforcement learning, using the task performance of revised harnesses as the reward. At test time, the proposer uses feedback from successive executions on a new task to refine the harness, without performing any parameter-space update. Experiments on reasoning and multi-hop question answering show that harness learning improves revision quality and that the ability to adapt at test time transfers to unseen tasks. Policies trained on individual revisions can continue improving harnesses over multiple rounds, while the benefits of training on revision sequences vary across settings. These findings suggest a path towards continually learning agents that turn accumulated experience into generalizable improvements.
blocks.zh: 一个语言模型代理由它的模型和它的杠杆,组织模型调用,工具使用和信息流的可执行程序共同定义. 由于不同的任务需要以不同的方式来组织这些行动,因此需要利用手头的任务的反馈来调整这种利用. 运用执行反馈来修改解答者的处理方式。 我们将这一进程发展为元学习,而不是可执行方案,利用修订在基于梯度的适应中起到加权更新的作用。 我们通过强化学习来训练求婚者,利用订正的吊带作为奖励。 在测试时间,提议者使用连续处决的反馈,对一项新任务进行精炼,而不执行任何参数-空间更新. 关于推理和多跳问题回答的实验表明,利用学习可以提高修订质量,在测试时能够适应隐形任务. 就个别修订问题培训的政策可以继续通过多轮培训加以改进,而修订序列培训的好处则因背景而异。 这些调查结果表明,要通过不断学习促进因素,将积累的经验转化为普遍的改进。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A harness is the executable program that organizes calls to a foundation model and interactions with tools ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Khattab et al., 2024 ) . It determines what the model sees, which tools it can use, and how execution proceeds. Because these choices strongly shape performance ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) , adapting the harness provides a way to improve how a model uses its capabilities without changing its parameters ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Lou et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 牵引装置是一个可执行的程序,它组织对一个基础模型的呼叫以及与工具的互动(Yang等人,2024年;Khattab等人,2024年)。 它决定了模型所看到的,它可以使用哪些工具,以及执行如何进行. 因为这些选择强烈地塑造了性能(Shinn等人,2023年;Yang等人,2024年),使这种牵引方式提供了一种改善模型如何在不改变参数的情况下利用其能力的方法(Zhang等人,2025b;Lou等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Execution feedback can guide choices about model calls, tool use, and intermediate outputs, but finding effective harness revisions often requires repeated experimentation at test time, and revisions that work on one task may not transfer to another. We therefore ask whether a model can learn to revise harnesses from execution feedback in a way that generalizes to new tasks . We call this problem harness learning and view it as meta-learning over executable programs ( Duan et al., 2016 ; Finn et al., 2017 ) . The outer loop trains a revision model, which we call the proposer , from execution outcomes, and the inner loop uses the proposer to adapt a harness from execution feedback. Training therefore learns a reusable revision procedure that can transfer to unseen tasks without updating model parameters at test time ( Baxter, 2000 ; Andrychowicz et al., 2016 ) .
blocks.zh: 执行反馈可以指导模型调用,工具使用和中间输出的选择,但找到有效的利用修改往往需要测试时重复实验,而一项任务工作的修改可能不会转移到另一项任务. 因此,我们问,一个模式是否能够学习如何从执行反馈中修改利用方式,以便概括到新的任务。 我们称这个问题为利用学习,并将其视为可执行方案的元学习(Duan等人,2016年;Finn等人,2017年)。 外环从执行结果出发, 使用内环从执行反馈中调用。 因此,培训学习了可重复使用的修订程序,这种程序可以在试验时不更新模型参数的情况下转移到看不见的任务(Baxter,2000年;Andrychowicz等人,2016年)。

blocks.en: We implement harness learning by training the proposer to edit executable harness code ( Fig. 1 ). Given a task description, the current harness, and an execution report, the proposer generates a code change. We train the proposer with reinforcement learning, using the performance of the resulting harness as the reward, and optionally initialize it with supervised fine-tuning. At test time, the same proposer can be applied repeatedly, using feedback from each execution to guide the next revision.
blocks.zh: 我们通过培训提议者来编辑可执行的绳索代码(图1)。 鉴于任务描述,当前牵引,以及执行报告,提议者生成代码更改. 我们通过强化学习来训练求婚者, 利用由此而来的吊带的性能作为奖励, 并选择初始化, 通过监督的微调。 在测试时,同一提议者可以反复应用,利用每次执行的反馈来指导下一次修订.

blocks.en: We evaluate harness learning on reasoning and multi-hop question answering. On Reasoning Gym ( Stojanovski et al., 2025 ) , training improves revision quality on task families excluded from both supervised and reinforcement learning, and in single-step revision the trained 4B proposer outperforms the 35B teacher on average. In multi-hop question answering, a proposer trained on HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) transfers to MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) and 2WikiMultihopQA ( Ho et al., 2020 ) . In both settings, trained proposers can continue improving harnesses over successive rounds of test-time adaptation. In QA, even a proposer trained only on seed-harness inputs continues improving revised harnesses, suggesting generalization across adaptation contexts and tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们评价如何学习推理和多跳问答。 关于 " 合理学习 " (Stojanovski等人,2025年),培训提高了被排斥在监督学习和强化学习之外的任务家庭的修订质量,在单步骤的修订中,经过培训的4B提议者平均比35B教师要好。 在多跳问答中,一名提议者接受了HotpotQA(杨等人,2018年)的训练,转会至MuSiQue(Trivedi等人,2022年)和2Wiki MultihopQA(Ho等人,2020年). 在这两种情况下,经过培训的求婚者可以在连续几轮的试验时间适应中继续改进利用。 在质量保证中,即使是只接受种子harness投入培训的求婚者,也继续改进订正的利用方式,建议在适应的背景和任务中加以概括。

blocks.en: We make the following contributions.
blocks.zh: 我们作出以下贡献。

blocks.en: Learning to adapt executable harnesses at test time. We introduce harness learning as meta-learning over executable programs: a model learns from execution outcomes how to revise the harness that organizes model calls and tool use. At test time, the model uses execution feedback to adapt harnesses for new tasks without any parameter updates.
blocks.zh: 在测试时间学习如何适应可执行的吊带. 我们引入了将学习作为元学习,而不是可执行程序:一个模型从执行结果中学习,如何修改组织模型调用和工具使用的方法。 在测试时,该模型使用执行反馈来调整对新任务的利用,而没有任何参数更新.

blocks.en: Generalization to unseen tasks. We show that the capability of test-time adaptation via harness revision transfers to reasoning tasks and question-answering benchmarks that are unseen during training.
blocks.zh: 概括到隐形任务 。 我们表明,通过利用修订工作向推理任务和问答基准的转移来适应试验时间的能力是培训期间所没有的。

blocks.en: Iterative test-time adaptation. We show that proposers trained on individual revisions can continue improving harnesses over successive rounds of test-time adaptation. We analyze how training changes the reliability of the revision, the structure of the auxiliary, and the use of generated tools.
blocks.zh: 迭代测试时间适应. 我们显示,经过个别修订培训的求婚者可以在连续几轮试验时间调整中继续改进利用情况。 我们分析训练如何改变修改的可靠性,辅助结构,以及使用生成的工具.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Automated agent design optimizes language-model pipelines and workflows ( Khattab et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) , with harness-specific methods using execution feedback to revise the programs that govern agent behavior ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Lou et al., 2026 ) . Concurrent work also trains dedicated models for harness construction and revision ( Shao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Harness-R1 trains an editor through supervised initialization and reinforcement learning with a frozen solver, a training recipe similar to ours. JIT-Agent learns task-conditioned harness generation, repair, and evolution. Our study frames harness revision as a learned adaptation procedure and examines whether successive rounds of execution feedback improve performance on task families excluded from training.
blocks.zh: 自动代理设计优化了语言模型管道和工作流程(Khattab等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2025年b),并采用了利用执行反馈的专有方法来修改管理代理行为的程序(Lee等人,2026年;Lou等人,2026年). 同时期工作还培训了利用建造和修正的专用模型(Shao等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026a年)。 Harness-R1通过有监督的初始化和强化学习来训练一个编辑器,使用冷冻溶解器,一种类似于我们的培训食谱. JIT-Agent学习任务条件下的牵引力生成,修理,进化. 我们的研究框架将修订作为一种学习到的适应程序,并审查连续几轮执行反馈是否改善了被排除在培训之外的任务家庭的业绩。

blocks.en: Meta-learning uses experience across tasks to learn an initialization or an adaptation procedure ( Duan et al., 2016 ; Finn et al., 2017 ; Hospedales et al., 2022 ) . AdaptFlow learns a shared workflow initialization ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , and The Last Harness proposes an outer loop over harness-evolution blueprints ( Seong et al., 2026 ) . Our formulation treats executable harness code as the adapted object and trains the proposer as the adaptation rule. Treating harness code as the adapted object lets the inner loop change control flow, tool interfaces, and the sequence of model calls, and the proposer learns from execution feedback how to make these discrete changes. At test time, both proposer and solver remain frozen, and graded execution feedback on development questions guides successive harness revisions. TTHE also adapts executable harnesses with frozen models, using unlabeled execution traces as feedback ( Nie et al., 2026 ) . Appendix A discusses broader adaptation methods and evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: Meta-learning利用跨任务的经验学习初始化或适应程序(Duan等人,2016年;Finn等人,2017年;Hospedales等人,2022年)。 适应 Flow学习了共享工作流程初始化(Zhu et al.,2025),The Last Harness则提出一个外部循环,凌驾于驾驭-进化蓝图之上(Seong et al.,2026). 我们的提法将可执行带码视为可执行对象,将培训提议者视为可执行规则。 将牵引码作为改造对象,让内环变化控制流,工具接口,以及模型调用顺序,提议者从执行反馈中学习如何做出这些离散变化. 在测试时,提议者和解决者都保持冻结状态,对发展问题的执行反馈进行分级,以指导连续的利用修订。 TTHE还用冷冻的模型改造可执行带,使用无标签的执行痕迹作为反馈(Nie等人,2026年). 附 录 一份讨论更广泛的适应方法和评价协议。

blocks.en: 3 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en: 3.1 Harness
blocks.zh: 3.1 合理性

blocks.en: Given a language model, a harness is the executable program that orchestrates the model’s calls throughout a task. The harness constructs the context for each model call, controls when calls occur, executes tool requests, and incorporates environmental feedback to support iterative problem solving. Harness design determines how a model interacts with its environment. For example, a coding-agent harness can expose tools for inspecting files, editing code, and running tests, then return the resulting observations to the model ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . A harness can be changed while the model’s parameters stay fixed.
blocks.zh: 在语言模式下, 牵引器是可执行的程序, 牵引装置构建每个模型调用的背景,调用时的控制,执行工具请求,并纳入环境反馈以支持迭代问题解决. 合理性设计决定了一个模型如何与其环境相互作用. 例如,一个编码代理机可以曝光用于检查文件,编辑代码和运行测试的工具,然后将所得出的观测结果退回模型(Yang等人,2024年). 当模型的参数保持不变时,可以改变牵引装置。

blocks.en: Single-step training treats each parent harness and report as an independent revision context. Training on successive revisions constructs additional contexts from selected candidate harnesses and their refreshed execution reports. For Reasoning Gym, we refresh these states between offline training phases; for QA, we generate revision sequences online. Each state uses the same immediate-reward update, so both procedures train the proposer to improve the harness presented in its current input. Section 5.1 and Appendix B.4 describe the configurations. We call the resulting configurations Single-step RL and Multistep RL. Either trained proposer can be applied over multiple revision rounds at test time.
blocks.zh: 单步培训将每个家长加以利用,并作为独立的修订背景报告。 关于连续修订的培训从选定的候选人及其最新执行情况报告中增加了一些背景。 对于理性健身,我们在离线训练阶段之间更新这些状态;对于QA,我们在网上生成修正序列. 每个州都采用相同的即时奖励更新,因此两种程序都训练提议者,以改善其当前投入中呈现的牵引力. 第5.1节和附录B.4描述了配置。 我们称由此产生的配置为单步RL和多步RL. 任一经过培训的求婚者可在试验时在多个修订回合中适用。

blocks.en: To evaluate harness learning, we organize our experiments around three questions: • Do learned revisions generalize to tasks unseen during training? • Does successive test-time revision improve harnesses beyond a single revision? • Does training on revision sequences improve adaptation over training on individual revisions? We study these questions in two settings with separately trained proposers. Reasoning Gym tests generalization across diverse synthetic task families from a minimal seed harness that makes one solver call. Multi-hop question answering tests whether learned revisions improve an existing retrieval workflow.
blocks.zh: 为了评价利用学习,我们围绕三个问题组织我们的实验: • 学习到的修订是否概括到培训期间未见的任务? • 连续的试验时间修订是否在单一修订之外改进了利用手段? 关于修订序列的培训是否比关于个别修订的培训改进适应? 我们在两个场合研究这些问题,分别由经过培训的求婚者研究。 理由说明 基因测试从最小的种子牵引器中 概括到不同的合成任务家族 多跳问题回答测试所学到的修改是否改善了现有的检索工作流程.

blocks.en: Both training stages improve mean single-revision scores on 21 unseen families, from 0.32 for Base to 0.62 after RL ( Fig. 3 , Appendix B.1 ). The improvement appears in the mean over all proposals, so it does not depend on selecting the best candidate. After RL, the average proposal already exceeds the seed harness, while Base and SFT proposals fall below it on average.
blocks.zh: 两个培训阶段都提高了21个隐形家庭的平均单次校正分数,从基地的0.32分提高到RL后的0.62分(图3,附录B.1)。 对所有提案而言,情况有改进,因此,这不取决于选择最佳候选人。 在RL之后,平均建议已经超过了种子牵引,而Base和SFT建议平均低于它.

blocks.en: On the 21 unseen families, the trained 4B proposer’s revisions score above those of its 35B teacher on average (0.62 versus 0.56) under the same revision protocol. The teacher achieves higher scores under oracle best-of-eight selection. Learning from execution outcomes after supervised initialization can therefore raise average proposal quality above the teacher’s. Appendix B.1 details the comparison, including the treatment of failed edits and zero-scoring harnesses.
blocks.zh: 在21个看不见的家庭中,经过培训的4B提案人的修订得分平均高于同一修订协议下的35B教师(0.62比0.56)。 老师在甲骨文精选下获得更高的分数. 因此,在监督初始化之后学习执行结果可以提高平均建议书质量高于教师。 附录B.1详细介绍了比较情况,包括处理失败的编辑和零评分带.

blocks.en: On format-varied questions, Single-step RL obtains most of its five-round gain in the first revision, while SFT improves more gradually across rounds ( Fig. 4 b). On canonical questions, the two proposers improve on similar schedules ( Fig. 4 a). Section 6.3 discusses why later revisions add less.

blocks.en: Both RL proposers continue to improve beyond the first revision and finish above Base on all three benchmarks, including the two unseen ones, while Base ends below the seed on HotpotQA and MuSiQue ( Fig. 5 a–c). Improvement also persists over more rounds than on Reasoning Gym, and the first revision accounts for only one third to two thirds of the ten-round gain. Section 6.3 discusses this difference.

blocks.en: On MuSiQue, Single-step RL averages 0.15 exact match for independent revisions, only marginally above the seed ( Table 24 ), versus 0.27 after ten revision rounds. On both unseen benchmarks, the average final run of each RL proposer exceeds even the oracle best of 80 independent proposals ( Fig. 5 d–e). Average improvement from the seed therefore does not fully capture a proposer’s ability to improve harnesses through repeated adaptation. Each run uses 80 proposals, so the comparison matches the number of proposals per run and leaves total compute and feedback unmatched.
blocks.zh: 在MuSiQue上,单步RL对独立修订的平均精确比0.15,仅略高于种子(表24),而经过十轮修订后则为0.27。 在两个未见的基准中,每个RL提案人的平均最终运行量甚至超过了80个独立提案中最优秀的(图5 d-e)。 因此,种子的平均改善不能完全抓住提议者通过反复调整改进利用的能力。 每次运行使用80个提案,因此比较与每次运行的建议书数量相符,使得总计算和反馈无法匹配.

blocks.en: 5.4 Effect of training on revision sequences
blocks.zh: 5.4 培训对修订序列的影响

blocks.en: Training on successive revision contexts with immediate rewards does not consistently improve on training on individual revisions. On Reasoning Gym, Multistep RL ends above Single-step RL on canonical questions and below it on format-varied questions ( Fig. 4 a,b), and training on fixed later-round states also shows no gain ( Appendix C.3 ). In QA, the two configurations reach nearly identical final scores ( Fig. 5 a–c). In both settings, proposers trained only on individual revisions already improve harnesses over successive rounds, which suggests that iterative improvement can emerge from single-revision training.
blocks.zh: 关于连续修订情况的培训,只要立即得到奖励,就无法持续改进关于个别修订的培训。 在理性健身上,多步RL在单步RL上方结束于犬科问题,在单步RL下方结束于格式变异的问题(图4 a,b),关于固定后轮状态的培训也显示无益(附录C.3). 在QA中,两种配置最终得分几乎相同(图5 a–c). 在这两种情况下,只接受个别修订培训的求婚者已经在连续几轮中改进了利用情况,这表明单审培训可以产生迭代改进。

blocks.en: 6 Analysis and Discussion
blocks.zh: 6. 分析和讨论

blocks.en: We examine how training changes the reliability and structure of proposals, and what these changes suggest about repeated revision.
blocks.zh: 我们审查培训如何改变建议的可靠性和结构,以及这些变化对反复修订有何建议。

blocks.en: 6.1 Training improves proposal reliability
blocks.zh: 6.1 培训提高提案的可靠性

blocks.en: Training reduces the fraction of proposals that fail to produce a runnable harness or score zero on the development questions ( Fig. 6 a,d; Table 10 ). On unseen Reasoning Gym families, most of the reduction comes from RL, and SFT alone leaves the rate nearly unchanged. In QA, RL from the base proposer produces a similar reduction. A trained proposer therefore supplies more viable candidates to selection in each round, which may help sustain progress across successive revisions.
blocks.zh: 培训减少了未能在发展问题上产生可操作性或得分为零的提案的比例(图6a、d;表10)。 而在未见的理性健身家庭,减幅大多来自RL,而光是SFT就使得率几乎保持不变. 在质评中,来自基建议者的RL产生类似的减少. 因此,训练有素的求婚者为每一轮的甄选提供更可行的候选人,这可能有助于在历次订正中保持进展。

blocks.en: 6.2 Qualitative analysis of learned harnesses
blocks.zh: 6.2 对学习到的器具进行定性分析

blocks.en: Figure 7 : A learned QA revision. The answering call reads retrieved passages directly (red), and first-hop summaries still guide retrieval.
blocks.zh: 图7:已了解的质量保证修订。 接听电话直接读取的段落(红色),第一跳摘要仍然指导检索.

blocks.en: On Reasoning Gym, SFT and Single-step RL mostly generate interpreter loops, which let the solver formulate a computation as code and delegate its execution to the runtime ( Fig. 6 b; Table 18 ). Interpreter loops are also the most common structure in the SFT data (48% of teacher revisions; Appendix B.2 ) and remain dominant after RL. Under a composition directive, helpers contribute to the answer in only a minority of the harnesses that integrate them into the solver’s tool loop ( Fig. 6 c), and composition rewards do not yield consistent gains ( Appendix C.4 ). Unsuccessful composed harnesses often pair a correct helper algorithm with failures in question parsing, tool communication, or answer extraction ( Table 21 ), so a generated component contributes only when these interfaces also work.
blocks.zh: 在Reasoning Gym上,SFT和Single-step RL大多生成解释器循环,这使得解析器制定一个作为代码的计算并将其执行委托给运行时间(图6b;表18). 口译环路也是SFT数据中最常见的结构(占教师修订版的48%;附录B.2),在RL之后仍然占主导地位. 根据一项组成指令,帮助者只用一小部分将这些问题纳入解决者工具循环的装置(图6c)来帮助解决问题,组成奖励不能产生一致的收益(附录C.4)。 不成功的编组拉带往往将一个正确的帮助算法与问题解析,工具通信,或解答提取(表21)中的失败配对,所以一个生成的组件只有在这些接口也起作用时才会作出贡献.

blocks.en: In QA, RL preserves multi-hop retrieval, while Base sometimes reduces the harness to a single solver call or removes the solver ( Fig. 6 e). A common RL revision keeps summaries for guiding the next retrieval and passes retrieved passages directly to the answering call ( Fig. 7 ), which separates the evidence needed to formulate a query from the evidence needed to answer. Other revisions add a third retrieval hop or search again when a draft answer is absent from the retrieved passages ( Fig. 15 ). In both settings, the trained proposers change how the harness organizes computation and information. Their transfer to unseen tasks suggests that they learn a reusable adaptation capability from execution outcomes.
blocks.zh: 在QA中,RL保留了多跳检索,而Base有时会将带子减少为单个解调器调用或删除解调器(图6 e). 通用的RL修订版保留了摘要,用于指导下一次检索,并将检索的段落直接传递给应答电话(图7),这把提出查询所需的证据与回答所需的证据分开。 其他修改则在检索的段落中缺少答复草稿时,再添加第三个检索跳跃或检索(图15)。 在这两种情况下,训练有素的求婚者都改变着如何组织计算和信息。 他们转入隐形任务表明,他们从执行结果中学习了可重复使用的适应能力。

blocks.en: 6.3 Repeated revision
blocks.zh: 6.3 重复修订

blocks.en: The seed harness may explain why QA gains accumulate over more rounds than Reasoning Gym gains. On Reasoning Gym, single-step revisions commonly introduce interpreter loops. In the composition experiments, a correct helper algorithm may still fail to contribute through the surrounding parsing and tool interfaces, which is one obstacle to further gains. The QA seed already contains a retrieval workflow whose depth, evidence access, and search triggers can each be refined in later rounds. Differences in training and selection procedures prevent attributing this contrast solely to the starting harness.
blocks.zh: 种子控制装置可以解释为什么质量保证收益的积累比理性健身收益多。 在Reasoning Gym上,单步修改通常引入解释器循环. 在组成实验中,一个正确的帮助算法仍然可能无法通过周围的剖析和工具接口作出贡献,这是进一步收益的一个障碍. QA种子已经包含一个检索工作流程,其深度,证据访问,和搜索触发器可以在以后的几轮中分别完善. 培训和甄选程序的差异使这种对比不能完全归因于最初的利用。

blocks.en: Repeated revision also tests whether a policy remains useful as its own edits change the adaptation context. In QA, Single-step RL trains on seed-harness inputs yet continues to improve revised harnesses at test time ( Fig. 5 ). This continued improvement suggests that the learned revision skills of Single-step RL extend to intermediate harnesses and execution reports beyond those encountered in training, as well as to unseen benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 反复修订还检验一项政策是否仍然有用,因为政策本身的编辑会改变适应的背景。 在质量保证中,单步RL列车在种子harness投入上仍然在继续改进试验时的订正牵引装置(图5)。 这一持续改进表明, " 单步 " 软件的学习修订技能已扩展到培训中遇到的中间手段和执行报告之外,以及无形的基准。

blocks.en: Our experiments on training with revision sequences change the parent harnesses and execution reports used for training and keep each reward local to a single revision ( Section 4.3 ). They leave open whether training that assigns credit across rounds would make longer revision chains more effective. Supervised demonstrations of successive revisions, or different distributions of intermediate harnesses and feedback, could yield larger gains from multistep training.
blocks.zh: 我们关于修订序列培训的实验改变了父母对培训的利用和实施情况报告,将每次奖励保留在一次修订(第4.3节)。 他们对分批发放信贷的培训是否会使较长的修订链更加有效持开放态度。 所监督的连续修订示范,或中间带和反馈的不同分布,可以从多步骤培训中获得更大的收益。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Harness learning trains a proposer to adapt a frozen solver’s executable harness using execution feedback, with both models’ parameters fixed at test time. On 21 unseen Reasoning Gym families, SFT followed by RL raises mean single-step revision scores from 0.32 with the base proposer to 0.62, with the trained 4B proposer outperforming its 35B teacher on average. In multi-hop QA, a proposer trained with RL from the base proposer on HotpotQA transfers to unseen benchmarks. Policies trained on individual revisions also improve harnesses over multiple rounds, suggesting that learned revision skills remain useful as the harness changes.
blocks.zh: 使用执行反馈来调整冷冻溶解器的可执行工具, 在未见的21个理性健身家庭中,SFT之后的RL将平均单步修订分数从0.32分(基数提议者)提高到0.62分,训练有素的4B提议者平均优于其35B级教师。 在多跳QA中,一名从HotpotQA转让到隐形基准的基建提议人接受RL训练的求婚者. 在个别修订方面接受培训的政策也改进了多轮的利用,表明随着利用方式的改变,学到的修订技能仍然有用。

blocks.en: Limitations and future work. Training uses prescribed revision prompts and a fixed solver, with one teacher for Reasoning Gym supervision. Future work could explore stronger teachers or direct RL from models with prior knowledge of harness design, train tool-using proposers to inspect and test designs, and jointly optimize proposer and solver following concurrent work ( Ornith, 2026a ; Ornith, 2026b ) . We emphasize transfer to unseen tasks and longer tool-use trajectories ( Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 培训使用规定的修订提示和一个固定的解答器,其中一名教师负责合理健身监督。 未来的工作可以探索更强的教师或从以前对利用设计有了解的模型中指导RL,培训使用工具的求婚者检查和测试设计,并在同时工作之后联合优化提议者和解答者(Ornith, 2026a;Ornith, 2026b)。 我们强调向看不见的任务和较长的工具使用轨迹转移(附录F)。

blocks.en: Appendix A Extended Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 扩大的相关工作

blocks.en: Harness optimization improves executable agent programs through search or learned editing policies. DSPy optimizes modular language-model pipelines, while AFlow searches over code-based workflows ( Khattab et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Meta-Harness and AutoHarness revise harnesses from execution feedback ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Lou et al., 2026 ) , and Ecdysis aggregates failures across instances to guide repairs ( Yue et al., 2026 ) . EvoHarness-RL learns to manage external belief, progress, and experience state during execution ( Ning et al., 2026 ) . WHALE ( Kim et al., 2026 ) alternates model weight updates with optimization of the harness with a stronger harness proposer, improving agent performance beyond optimizing a single component alone.
blocks.zh: Harness优化通过搜索或学习编辑政策改进可执行代理程序. DSPy优化了模块化语言模型管道,而AFlow搜索基于代码的工作流程(Khattab等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2025年b). Meta-Harness和AutoHarness修改了执行反馈中的杠杆(Lee等人,2026年;Lou等人,2026年),以及Ecdysis汇总了各种案例的失败,以指导修复(Yue等人,2026年). EvoHarness-RL在处决期间学习管理外部信仰、进步和经验状态(Ning等人,2026年)。 WHALE(Kim et al., 2026年) 备用模型重量更新,以更强的吊带提议器优化了吊带,改善了代理性能,超越了仅优化单个组件.

blocks.en: Harness-R1, JIT-Agent, and Ornith are contemporary efforts to learn harness construction or revision. They share our interest in learning from execution outcomes and differ from our work in training signal, adaptation process, and scope of transfer evaluation ( Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: Harness-R1,JIT-Agent,和Ornith是当代学习驾驭构造或修正的努力. 他们同我们一样有兴趣学习执行结果,并与我们在培训信号、适应进程和转让评价范围方面的工作不同(表2)。

blocks.en: Shao et al. (2026) train a dedicated editor with GPT-5.5 demonstrations followed by GRPO, keeping the target agent frozen. Their SFT, RL, validation, and test partitions contain disjoint instances from the same three benchmarks. They also evaluate patches on instances withheld from adaptation feedback and transfer the editor to unseen target models. Our transfer evaluation excludes entire reasoning families from both training stages and tests a HotpotQA-trained policy on MuSiQue and 2WikiMultihopQA. During Harness-R1 training, rewards come from rerunning the batch that supplied the failure feedback; our scoring questions are disjoint from the feedback questions. Their procedure generates patches without successive refinement of the same patch, whereas we study repeated revision and training on successive revision states. Supervised initialization followed by RL is shared with our Reasoning Gym setting. Our QA proposer starts RL directly from the base proposer, with no teacher-generated revision demonstrations ( Section 5.1 ).
blocks.zh: Shao等人(2026年)用GPT-5.5的演示训练了一台专用编辑器,随后是GRPO,使目标代理被冻结. 它们的SFT,RL,验证,和测试分区包含与同一三个基准的脱节实例. 他们还评价了从适应反馈中扣下的实例补丁,并将编辑器转移到隐形目标模型. 我们的转移评估将整个推理家庭排除在培训阶段之外,并测试一项经过热点QA培训的关于MuSiQue和2Wiki MultihopQA的政策。 在Harness-R1训练中,奖励来自重跑提供故障反馈的批次;我们的评分问题与反馈问题脱节. 他们的程序产生补丁而不连续完善同一补丁,而我们则研究连续修订状态的反复修订和培训. 由RL监督初始化后与我们的理性健身设定共享. 我们的QA提议者直接从基数提议者开始RL,没有教师产生的修订演示(第5.1节).

blocks.en: Zhang et al. (2026a) learn task-conditioned harness generation, repair, and evolution within a four-module protocol. Training combines teacher SFT, execution-based DPO, supervised repair, and Evo-GDPO, which rewards improvements over archive incumbents while accounting for task performance, latency, and cost. Its streaming setting also accumulates execution experience to improve subsequent harnesses. JIT-Agent and our work both study learned adaptation from feedback. JIT-Agent organizes adaptation around task instances and an expanding harness archive; our revision sequences update a current harness evaluated across multiple instances within a task family, with transfer measured on families or benchmarks excluded from training.
blocks.zh: 张等(2026a)在四单元协议内学习任务条件下的牵引力生成,修理,进化. 培训将教师SFT、基于执行的DPO、有监督的修理和Evo-GDPO结合起来,奖励改进档案的任职者,同时说明任务执行情况、延迟性和成本。 它的流派设置还积累了执行经验,以改善后续的利用. 联合信息技术机构代理人和我们的工作都从反馈中汲取了适应性。 联合信息技术机构-代理人围绕任务实例和不断扩大的利用档案组织适应工作;我们的修订序列更新了在任务家庭内对多个情况进行评估的现有利用情况,并按家庭或基准计量转移,被排除在培训之外。

blocks.en: Ornith-1.0 jointly trains a policy to generate scaffolds and solve tasks using rewards from solution rollouts ( Ornith, 2026a ) . Ornith-1.5 extends this loop to jointly optimize task generation, harness generation, and solution rollouts ( Ornith, 2026b ) . These contemporary releases couple improvements in scaffolding with changes to the task-solving policy. Our training updates only the proposer and keeps the solver fixed, so harness improvements are evaluated with unchanged solver parameters. At test time, both models remain fixed while execution feedback guides code revision.
blocks.zh: Ornith-1.0联合培训一项政策,利用解决方案推出(Ornith, 2026a)的奖励来生成脚手架和解决任务. Ornith-1.5将这一循环扩展为联合优化任务生成、利用生成和解决方案推出(Ornith, 2026b). 这些当代出版物结合任务解决政策的改变,在脚手架上作了一些改进。 我们的训练只更新了求婚者,并保持了解调器的固定,因此利用不变的解调器参数来评价利用率的提高. 在测试时,两种模型都保持固定,而执行反馈则指导代码修订.

blocks.en: Table 2: Contemporary approaches to learned harness adaptation. Columns give each method’s training signal and adaptation process. The accompanying text compares their transfer evaluations.
blocks.zh: 表2 当代利用适应办法。 各栏显示每种方法的培训信号和适应过程。 所附案文比较了它们的转让评价。

blocks.en: Meta-learning uses experience across tasks to improve adaptation to new tasks ( Hospedales et al., 2022 ) . MAML learns an initialization for gradient-based adaptation ( Finn et al., 2017 ) , while RL 2 encodes a reinforcement learning algorithm in a recurrent policy ( Duan et al., 2016 ) . AdaptFlow learns a shared workflow initialization through language-guided updates ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . The Last Harness proposes an outer loop over harness-evolution blueprints ( Seong et al., 2026 ) , and EvoX jointly evolves solutions and their search strategies ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Meta-RL methods also learn to use interaction histories and reflections ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , convert rubric-based judgments into reusable guidance ( Li et al., 2026 ) , or train LLMs on diverse interaction trajectories to learn transferable exploration strategies, enabling adaptation to unseen tasks through environmental feedback in context without further parameter updates ( Tajwar et al., 2025 ) . Our proposer maps a harness and execution feedback to a code revision. Training uses immediate revision rewards as a greedy surrogate for final harness quality ( Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: Meta-learning利用跨任务的经验改进适应新的任务(Hospedales等人,2022年). MAML学习一个基于梯度的适应的初始化(Finn等人,2017年),而RL 2编码了一个重复政策中的强化学习算法(Duan等人,2016年). 适应 Flow通过语言指导更新学习共享工作流程初始化(Zhu等人,2025年). "最后的哈尼斯"(The Last Harness)提出一个绕过驾驭-进化蓝图的外环(Seong et al., 2026),EvoX联合发展解决方案及其搜索策略(Liu et al., 2026). 迈塔 - RL方法还学习使用互动历史和反思(Yang等人,2026年),将基于文字的判断转化为可重复使用的指导(Li等人,2026年),或对各种互动轨迹的LLMs进行学习可转移探索战略的训练,通过环境反馈,在不进一步更新参数的情况下适应无形的任务(Tajwar等人,2025年)。 我们的求婚者给代码修订 绘制了运行反馈图 培训将立即修订奖励作为贪婪的代理,以获取最终的利用质量(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: Self-improvement methods use feedback to update outputs, memory, code, or model parameters. Self-Refine revises model outputs ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) , and Reflexion stores verbal reflections for later attempts ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) . Feedback can also fail to sustain improvement ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . STOP improves the program that proposes code changes ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ) , and the Darwin Gödel Machine evolves agent code through a candidate archive ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . TTHE adapts harnesses from unlabeled execution traces with fixed model parameters ( Nie et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 自改进方法使用反馈来更新输出,内存,代码,或模型参数. Self-Refine修改了模型输出(Madaan等人,2023年),Reflexion存储了口头反射,供以后尝试(Shinn等人,2023年). 反馈也可能无法持续改善(Jiang等人,2025年)。 Stop改进了提出代码更改的程序(Zelikman等人,2024年),达尔文·格德尔机器通过候选存档(Zhang等人,2025a)演化代理代码. TTHE用固定的模型参数从无标签的处决痕迹中调适了绳索(Nie等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Other self-improvement methods update model parameters from self-generated training signals. STaR trains on generated rationales yielding correct answers ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) , and Self-Rewarding Language Models construct training preferences from model-generated rewards ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) . SEAL learns to generate fine-tuning data and update directives ( Zweiger et al., 2025 ) , while SIA combines harness and model-weight updates ( Hebbar et al., 2026 ) . Harness learning trains a separate proposer from revision outcomes with a fixed solver. At test time, both models remain frozen, and graded development feedback guides harness edits.
blocks.zh: 其他自改进方法从自生成的训练信号中更新模型参数. STAR列车基于生成的原理,给出正确的答案(Zelikman等人,2022年),以及自酬语言模型从模型产生的奖励中构建培训偏好(Yuan等人,2024年). 海豹突击队学习生成微调数据和更新指令(Zweiger等人,2025年),而SIA结合了牵引和模型重量更新(Hebbar等人,2026年). 机理学习从修订结果中培训一个单独的求婚者,并配备一个固定的解析器. 在测试时,两种模型仍然冻结,分级开发反馈指南利用编辑.

blocks.en: Harness evaluation accounts for solver capability, feedback, and search budgets. Wang et al. (2026b) examine benchmark overfitting under matched feedback and inference budgets, while Lin et al. (2026) distinguish generating useful updates from benefiting from them. HarnessCompass studies transfer through constrained edits and richer feedback ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and Evo-Bench evaluates evolution across held-out task suites ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Continual-learning evaluations test whether gains persist as tasks arrive ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . Our experiments fix the solver within each benchmark, separate development feedback from held-out scoring, and report average proposal scores, best-of-eight scores, and successive-revision performance. Evaluations across benchmarks and on families excluded from both training phases test transfer of the learned adaptation procedure.
blocks.zh: 合理性评价用于计算解析器的能力、反馈和搜索预算。 Wang等人(2026年b)在匹配的反馈和推论预算下审查基准过于吻合,而Lin等人. (2026)区分产生有用的更新与从中受益. 调和 Compass研究通过限制编辑和更丰富的反馈进行转移(Zhang等人,2026年b),Evo-Bench评价了被搁置任务套间的演变(Huang等人,2026年). 持续学习评价测试成果是否随着任务的到来而持续存在(Wang等人,2026a)。 我们的实验将解答器固定在每个基准内,将发展反馈从搁置的评分中分离出来,并报告平均的求婚分数,8分中的最佳分数,以及连续的校正性能. 跨基准的评价和关于被排除在两个培训阶段之外的家庭的评价,测试所学适应程序的转让。

blocks.en: Continual learning agents must acquire knowledge and skills from ongoing interaction while retaining useful experience. AgentOdyssey evaluates these abilities through procedurally generated, long-horizon text games, with diagnostics for exploration, world knowledge, and episodic memory ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . Methods address this challenge at both the parameter and program levels. For parametric memory, Zhang et al. (2026d) show that composing generative replay, self-distillation, and weight regularization with merged LoRA improves retention across sequential fine-tuning tasks. At the program level, Voyager accumulates reusable executable skills ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , while WorldCoder and Schema construct and revise executable world models from interaction feedback to support planning ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) . Harness learning complements these directions by learning how to revise the program that organizes model calls and tool use, with model parameters fixed at test time.
blocks.zh: 持续学习的代理人必须从不断的互动中获得知识和技能,同时保留有益的经验。 AgentOdyssey通过程序生成的,长视的文字游戏来评价这些能力,并有用于探索的诊断,世界知识,以及零星的记忆(张等人,2026c). 方法在参数和方案两级都应对这一挑战。 就参数记忆而言,张等人(2026d)表明,结合合并的LORA,形成基因重播、自我消化和重量正规化,可以改进顺序微调任务的保存。 在方案层面,Voyager积累了可重复使用的可执行技能(Wang等人,2023年),而WorldCoder和Schema则从互动反馈中构建和修改可执行的世界模型以支持规划(Tang等人,2024年;Zeng等人,2026年). 通过学习如何修改组织模型调用和工具使用的程序,在测试时间固定模型参数,哈妮斯学习补充了这些方向.

blocks.en: D.1 Datasets and retrieval
blocks.zh: D.1 数据集和检索

blocks.en: HotpotQA provides in-domain evaluation using 5.23 million Wikipedia abstracts from its full-wiki corpus. We sample disjoint sets of 2,000 training, 500 development, and 300 held-out test questions from its training split.
blocks.zh: HotpotQA使用其全维基百科中的523万维基百科摘要提供域内评价. 我们抽查了两千个培训、500个开发以及300个被搁置的测试问题,从培训中分离出来。

blocks.en: MuSiQue and 2WikiMultihopQA provide out-of-domain evaluation. We pool all supplied support and distractor paragraphs from their development splits (20 per question for MuSiQue-Ans and 10 for 2WikiMultihopQA) and deduplicate them by title and text. We partition each development split into disjoint development and held-out test sets, stratified by hop count for MuSiQue and question type for 2WikiMultihopQA. Table 22 lists the corpora and question counts. Development and test questions are disjoint from each other and from the 2,000-question training pool.

blocks.en: Parents come from 32 revision runs that the evolving policy advances, so the training states come from successive revisions. Each run starts at the seed harness, and contexts are ordered by run, so each run is visited once every eight updates. When a run is revisited, the candidate from its previous context with the highest exact match on the scoring questions becomes the new parent, following the best-of-eight rule used at inference. A run keeps its parent if none of the eight candidates executes. Ten visits per run give 320 contexts and 80 updates per phase. The two policies share every other setting ( Table 23 ), so the comparison isolates the source of the parent harness.
blocks.zh: 父母来自32次修订,即不断演变的政策进步,因此培训状态来自连续的修订。 每次运行从种子带开始,背景按运行顺序排列,因此每8次更新一次就访问每次运行. 复赛时,从以往背景来看,在评分问题上准确比分最高的候选人成为新的家长,遵循在推论中采用的八项最佳规则。 如果8名候选人中没有一人被执行,则跑步会维持其父母。 每期10次访问提供320次背景,每期80次更新。 这两种政策相互分享不同的环境(表23),因此比较将母机的源头隔离.

blocks.en: D.3 Multistep evaluation
blocks.zh: D.3 多步骤评价

blocks.en: All three benchmarks use the same two-hop retrieve-and-summarize seed. Each proposer performs four independent revision runs of T = 10 T=10 rounds from this seed. In each round, each run draws six feedback questions from the development pool and executes its current harness on them with traces. The report lists traces, answer correctness, gold answers, and retrieved or missed supporting documents ( Appendix E.2 ). Sixty-four scoring questions from the same pool, disjoint from all feedback questions of the round, are shared by the four runs. Development questions can recur across rounds, while feedback and scoring questions remain disjoint within each round. Each run samples G = 8 G=8 revisions and advances to the candidate with the highest scoring exact match, even when it scores below its parent. The Reasoning Gym protocol retains a candidate only when it improves the development score ( Appendix 3 ).
blocks.zh: 这三个基准都使用相同的双跳回和总结种子. 每个提议者从此种子中执行4个独立的修订赛跑T=10T=10轮. 在每轮中,每次运行从开发池中抽取6个反馈问题,并用痕迹执行当前对它们的控制. 报告列出了痕迹、答案正确性、黄金答案以及检索或遗漏的证明文件(附录E.2)。 同池的64个积分问题,与本轮所有反馈问题脱节,由四跑分享. 发展问题可能在各个回合中反复出现,而反馈和评分问题在每一回合中仍然相互脱节。 每个运行标本G=8G=8 修正和向得分最高的准确匹配候选人垫款,即使得分低于其母. 理性健身协议只有在提高发展分数时才保留一名候选人(附录3 )。

Dashed curves in the first three panels of Fig. 5 show the highest held-out score reached across all four runs up to each round. blocks.en: D.4 Single-step evaluation
blocks.zh: D.4 单步骤评价

blocks.en: For each dataset and RL checkpoint, we generate 80 independent proposals from the seed harness, using the round-one reports of the four revision runs and 20 samples per report. The pool size matches the 80 proposals that one revision run consumes in ten rounds. Each proposal receives the seed code and its execution feedback, produces one revised harness, and is scored by exact match on the held-out test set listed in Table 22 . Edits that fail to parse or compile receive zero. Identical programs share one execution, and all 80 proposals contribute to the reported statistics.

blocks.en: For Reasoning Gym, the report provides development-set scores and instance outcomes, failed-example trace excerpts, changes since earlier revisions, and the retained harness’s revision history. Independent proposals share the same parent and report. Their branch instruction directs different proposals toward distinct failure mechanisms, while successive revision obtains new feedback from the retained harness ( Appendix B.1 ). This distinction matters when comparing proposal budgets and adaptation over rounds.

blocks.en: E.3 Composition directives
blocks.zh: E.3 组成指令

blocks.en: Composition experiments compare the standard revision request with one that additionally asks for a reusable computational helper integrated into the solver’s tool loop. A more restrictive variant requests task-specific helpers instead of a generic code interpreter, along with checks of the resulting answer. These directives describe the desired harness structure; the structural and functional audits in Appendix C.4 measure what the proposals actually achieve. The study’s different training configurations and reward terms are specified in Table 16 and Eq. 10 .

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our Reasoning Gym supervision is limited to the harness designs produced by a single 35B teacher. Stronger teachers could provide more diverse harness designs and multistep revision demonstrations, potentially better preparing the proposer for subsequent multistep RL. Another direction is to start RL from a model with prior training in harness design and revision. Our QA experiments already use direct RL without teacher demonstrations. Whether an initialization with more knowledge of harness design improves exploration and transfer remains an open question.
blocks.zh: 我们的理由 健身监督仅限于单人35B教师制作的牵引设计. 更强壮的教师可以提供更多样化的利用设计和多步骤的修订示范,有可能更好地使提议者为随后的多步骤RL做好准备。 另一个方向是,从一个模型开始RL,先进行利用设计和修订方面的培训。 我们的QA实验已经使用了没有老师演示的直接RL. 对利用设计有较多知识的初始化是否改进了勘探和转让,仍然是一个有待解决的问题。

blocks.en: Current training uses prescribed revision prompts and externally generated execution reports. The proposer does not choose its own code-inspection or execution steps before submitting a revision. Future work could train the proposer inside a tool-using harness, allowing it to inspect code, run targeted tests, compare candidate designs, and revise them using the resulting observations. This would extend training from producing edits to choosing how to investigate and improve a harness, and could help explore designs that are difficult to elicit through prompt directives alone.
blocks.zh: 目前的培训使用规定的修订提示和外部生成的执行报告。 提案人在提交修订案前不选择自己的代码检查或执行步骤. 今后的工作可以对提议者进行使用工具的训练,使其能够检查代码,进行有针对性的测试,比较候选人设计,并利用由此产生的观测结果加以修改。 这将扩大培训范围,从制作编辑到选择如何调查和改进利用方式,并可帮助探索仅通过迅速指示难以获得的设计。

blocks.en: We keep the solver fixed during training, so our experiments do not examine whether learning to generate harnesses and learning to use them can reinforce each other. Concurrent work such as Ornith jointly trains scaffold generation and task solving ( Ornith, 2026a ; Ornith, 2026b ) . An extension of harness learning could jointly optimize the proposer and solver while retaining the goal of generalizable adaptation. A key question is whether this training yields revision skills that transfer to unseen task families and remain useful as the solver changes, particularly on tasks requiring longer sequences of tool use and intermediate decisions.
blocks.zh: 我们在训练期间固定解答器,因此我们的实验不检查学习产生带子和学习使用带子是否能够互相加强. Ornith联合培训脚手架一代和任务解决(Ornith,2026a;Ornith,2026b)等同时期工作. 推广利用学习可以联合优化提议者和解决者,同时保留通用适应的目标。 一个关键问题是,这种培训是否产生修订技能,将这种技能转让给看不见的任务家庭,并在解决者改变时仍然有用,特别是在需要较长的工具使用顺序和中间决定的任务方面。
